# Instance policies

This starter is owned by this vault. Choose its collection scope before importing knowledge. The schema defines allowed structures; source verification establishes what the evidence supports. Tool upgrades preserve these files.

Daily writes use the running Obsidian vault. Read the policy matching the task: [pages](pages.md), [kinds](kinds.md), [evidence](evidence.md), [claims](claims.md), [navigation](navigation.md), [attributes](attributes.md), [units](units.md).

# Pages

Use one globally unique lowercase hyphenated slug per object. Include type, title, description and generated (by and ISO 8601 at). Use Markdown links relative to the page; frontmatter page values use quoted wikilinks. Distinguish draft, deprecated and verified status. Only record human verification after an explicit human check.

# Kinds

Choose the object category from schema. Entity classes and their directories belong to this instance. A topic organizes links; an analysis makes a sourced judgment.

# Evidence

Keep originals in evidence/sources or evidence/records with a matching <original filename>.md card. Preserve original bytes and record SHA-256, source URL, access time, publisher and source grade. Cite the card through the page sources property; retain stable local citation IDs. Committed evidence is append-only. Read the schema and checker diagnostics for required metadata.

# Claims

Use structured Claims for scoped, time-bound, conflicting or estimated values; use frontmatter for applicable unscoped snapshots. Preserve precision and units. Every Claim names its evidence and locator; separate source statements, deterministic derivations and estimates. Agent verification means the cited evidence was checked, not that the world was proven correct.

# Navigation

Search title and aliases, then follow topic and directory indexes. Read only relevant pages and evidence excerpts. Check backlinks with refs before rename or merge. Update affected indexes and the bank log after writes.
